title: Capstone 3: Best Product per City
story: For each city, which product did its customers buy most (by qty, delivered)?
goal: Show city, product (name), and units (sum of qty) for the best-selling product in each city (ties: alphabetical product), ordered by city. Skip customers with no city.

tests.label: Hidden check on other data

hints: Aggregate per city and product in a CTE, then ROW_NUMBER partitioned by city.
Filter rn = 1 in the outer query. Remember c.city IS NOT NULL.

WITH t AS (SELECT c.city, p.name AS product, SUM(o.qty) AS units FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.city, p.name), r AS (SELECT city, product, units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY units DESC, product) AS rn FROM t) SELECT city, product, units FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY city;
socratic: What are the two grouping columns?
explain: In one sentence: what does this query do, and why does it need the a CTE?
solution: WITH t AS (SELECT c.city, p.name AS product, SUM(o.qty) AS units FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.city, p.name), r AS (SELECT city, product, units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY units DESC, product) AS rn FROM t) SELECT city, product, units FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY city;
alt: WITH t AS (SELECT c.city, p.name AS product, SUM(o.qty) AS units FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.city, p.name) SELECT city, product, units FROM (SELECT city, product, units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY units DESC, product) AS rn FROM t) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY city;
